cards.title: Entropy conditioned on an incomplete measurement record

source_refs.value: Main Fig. 2(b) caption and main-text statement that outcomes are retained only inside a spatial cutoff
Mixed-stabilizer reduction derived from the printed conditional entropy S_Q

cards.latex: S(R\mid M_A)=|R|-\dim S_R,\quad \dim S_R=r-\operatorname{rank}_{\mathbb F_2}(G_Q),\quad \mathcal D_Z(\rho)=\tfrac12(\rho+Z\rho Z)

checks.reason: The paper fixes the physical circuit and says only measurement outcomes inside the spatial bound are recorded; measurements outside the record therefore remain physical and must be marginalized.
For a rank-r mixed stabilizer group, the subgroup supported only on R is the kernel of restriction to Q, with dimension r-rank(G_Q).
For a Bell pair, an unrecorded Z measurement leaves S(R)=1, while conditioning on the outcome gives S(R)=0; the full-record mixed implementation matches the pure-trajectory implementation.
